public_rationale: Marcus says Wyatt Walls's guitarist example showed statistical frequency (most guitarists are right-handed) beating the meaning of a left-handed request. The images in his post and on X do not render as readable text. So I could not confirm the prompt or that the output showed a right-handed guitarist. Later informal reports on OpenAI's forum (2025) describe ChatGPT failing to draw left-handed guitarists and people. Users there guess that skewed training data is the cause. This is consistent with Marcus's account, but it is anecdotal, from a later model, and not a controlled test of the cause. I found no study isolating training-data frequency as the cause of handedness failures. The evidence fits his reading but does not settle the specific example or the causal claim.
limitations: Image-based tweets could not be inspected.
The causal attribution is interpretive. Other explanations, such as general weakness with left/right relations, were not ruled out by any source found.
The context sources are informal user posts.

statement.excerpt: Once again statistical frequency (most guitarists play righthanded) won out over linguistic understanding, to the consternation of Hendrix fans everywhere.
statement.document_title: Statistics versus Understanding: The Essence of What Ails Generative AI

from_speaker: Wyatt Walls ... extended the basic idea to something that didn't involve drawing at all
Once again statistical frequency (most guitarists play righthanded) won out over linguistic understanding
to the consternation of Hendrix fans
our_interpretation: Reading: Walls asked a generative image system (as of 2024-02-13, presumably ChatGPT/DALL-E 3) for a left-handed guitarist. The output showed a right-handed one. The cause was the model's reliance on the frequency of right-handed guitarists in its training data, not a failure to depict left-handed playing as such.

The claim has two parts. The factual part is that the output showed a right-handed guitarist despite a left-handed request. The causal part is that statistical frequency overrode the prompt's meaning.
The target period is the example's date, around 2024-02-13.
criteria.support_condition: Supported if a viewable record of Walls's example shows a right-handed guitarist despite a left-handed request, and credible evidence ties such failures to training-data frequency over prompt meaning. Examples of credible evidence: controlled tests showing systematic right-hand defaults when the left hand is explicitly requested, or analyses linking the failure to data prevalence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contradicted if Walls's example in fact showed a left-handed guitarist or the prompt did not request left-handedness. Also contradicted if controlled evidence showed that systems of that time reliably honored left-handed guitarist requests, or that the failure had a cause unrelated to data frequency.
